{# Link a repository path to its source on the forge. A trailing slash marks a directory. #} {# Components cannot read `config`; load the site configuration to keep the forge URL in zola.toml. #} {% component source(path: string, label: string = "") -%} {%- set site_config = load_data(path="zola.toml") -%} {%- set source = site_config.extra.source -%} {%- set source_kind = "blob" -%} {%- if path is ending_with(pat="/") -%}{%- set source_kind = "tree" -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set source_label = path -%} {%- if label -%}{%- set source_label = label -%}{%- endif -%} {{ source_label | escape }} {%- endcomponent source %}
